# Work handoff: reviewed one

## Goal
Review all four source partitions for continuity and user authority, then submit a source-grounded report with exact partition hashes.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not edit source, invent test results, or treat a completed partition as task completion.
- Review the actual supplied source and preserve hashes and concrete observations across folds.
- Use only the authorized review process; no tests have been run.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Reviewed partition 1, SHA-256 `4d6e7d18c24a5c7b23da8fa1b63b959baaa4622cfc9646ba2ca907ee9d6c851e`.

- [x] Noted a possible stale-item race in `extensions/navigate-tree/current-screen.ts` `edit`: it applies the edited item after awaiting the editor, using the pre-dialog item.

### In Progress
- [ ] Review partitions 2–4, preserve their hashes and findings, fold each partition, and submit the four-entry report.

### Blocked
- None.

## Key Decisions
- Preserve the partition 1 observations as verified facts, and label the possible `current-screen.ts` race as unverified.

## Next Steps
1. Review partition 2 source, record its exact hash and at least two concrete observations, then fold to `reviewed-two`.

## Standing authorization
“Work autonomously until all four partitions have been reviewed, all four folds have landed, and submit_report accepts the result.” This scope is not complete.
